title: Native formats and coordination
cards/0/body:
RVT is Revit’s native format, and it is closed. A file from a newer Revit will not open in an older one. PLN is Archicad’s native format.

The native format has everything: history, families, views, drawing sheets. IFC has only what is needed for exchange.
cards/1/body:
Disciplines are modeled in different programs, and Navisworks brings them into one scene.

NWC is a cache generated from each source file. NWD is a published federated model with all geometry inside, easy to view and check.
cards/1/deep: There is also NWF, a “list of links” to the source files: on open, Navisworks pulls in fresh NWCs. Clash detection (Clash Detective) lives in Navisworks Manage; in the cloud, services like Autodesk Construction Cloud take its place.
cards/2/task: Run a hard clash check between disciplines.
cards/3/q: How many hard clashes were found?
cards/3/explain: Duct D-7 runs straight through both beams.
cards/4/task: Pipes need 50 mm of clearance for insulation. Check with a 50 mm tolerance.
cards/5/q: Why did one more clash show up with 50 mm clearance?
cards/5/options/0: Pipe P-4 runs 10 mm below a beam: no intersection, but the insulation will not fit
cards/5/explain: This is a “soft” clash: the elements do not intersect, but the required clearance is violated.
cards/6/options/1: NWD is a federated model for viewing and checking
cards/6/options/2: NWC is generated from source files
cards/6/explain: IFC carries only exchange data. PLN is Archicad’s format.
